eyebrow: The sampling distribution of the mean

steps.label: Center
steps.sub: Sample means average to the true mean

code:
rng = np.random.default_rng(16)
pop = rng.exponential(scale=40,
                      size=1_000_000)
for n in (1, 5, 30, 100):
    means = rng.choice(
        pop, size=(5000, n)
    ).mean(axis=1)
caption: 5,000 samples per size n, then look at the means.
Output of the code above (illustrative, simulated order values).
Four times the data only halves the spread.
